entities.name: Kashtiliash III
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kaštiliašu III, phonetically inscribed in cuneiform as mKaš-til-ia-šu, was a possible Kassite king of Babylonia in the 15th century BC. He is known only from the Assyrian Synchronistic King List, a copy of a monumental inscription, his genealogy, and references in the Chronicle of Early Kings.
